card.name: Prepositions after handing or sharing objects
card.fires_on: Small place or recipient words such as around, to and between right after a physical object and a verb like give, carry, lie or share. Seen in label text on pens and test drinks, and in general web text.

modes.label: Give or hand to
modes.description: The word 'to' after a verb of handing an object to a person.
modes.example: Give the prepared test drink<< to>> the patient.

modes.label: Never share between patients
modes.description: The word 'between' after a pen or injection device name in a never-share warning.
modes.example: 5.2 Never Share a BYETTA Pen<< Between>> Patients BYETTA pens must never be

modes.label: Lying or carried around
modes.description: The word 'around' after lying or carries, describing an object kept nearby or moved about.
modes.example: you don’t have old obsolete CDs lying<< around>>.
